minimal_revisions_applied.reason: Clarify MIT 6.006 traversal order = in-order traversal (no query text change).
minimal_revisions_applied.original: To find the successor of node X: if X has a right child, return the first (leftmost) node in X's right subtree; otherwise, walk upward and return the lowest ancestor of X for which X lies in its left subtree (O(h) time). To delete a non-leaf node X: swap its item with its predecessor (if X has a left child) or with its successor (if X has a right child) and recursively delete down to a leaf in O(h) time.
minimal_revisions_applied.revised: Under MIT 6.006 convention, traversal order refers to in-order traversal (left subtree before node, right subtree after node).
